content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: ABIOC(AV and EDR Product Discovery via tasklist Piped to findstr in a Loader Lineage) AND (XQL(extrac32 Unpack and Renamed AutoIt3 Interpreter Execution Surfaced) OR XQL(Loader Stager Fetch and Lumma C2 Egress on the Network Plane)) on the same agent_hostname within the correlation window — fuses the real endpoint loader-lineage signal (the security-software-discovery burst and the benign extrac32 CAB unpack) with the network stager-fetch / Lumma C2 egress into ONE Lumma-loader incident spanning the EDR and NDR planes. The full mshta -> cmd -> extrac32 -> renamed-AutoIt3 causality chain (the model-only grouping ABIOC) is the narrative anchor; the correlation fires on the signals the SAFE-MODE run actually produces.
rules.name: ClickFix Lumma-Loader Chain — mshta-to-AutoIt3 Causality Stitch (EDR + NDR)
